name: Pipeliners - Buckeye SEO Test 2026-09-16
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-16

# Summary
Test tracker for the /buckeye/ rewrite (post 13796) from a Google Doc spec. Goal: average position 17.9 to below 10, plus clicks from trenchless pipe repair searches. The Doc rewrite went live Sep 1, 2026 20:42 UTC, so clean data starts Sep 2. Also covers the pipe-break section draft (`BUCKEYE-pipe-break-section-draft.md`).

# Key findings
- Baseline (Aug 2 to 29): GSC dashboard 1 click, 454 impressions, position 17.9; Search Atlas API 0 clicks, 418 impressions, position 18. Compare API to API only.
- Read 1 (Sep 11): week after vs week before, 71 impressions each, position 11 to 22. Site-wide control did not drop, so the slip was page-specific. Warning: "buckeye pipe break repair" (30 impressions at position 6 the week before) went to zero property-wide; the rewritten copy had no "pipe break", "burst" or "break".
- Read 2 (Sep 16): impressions 103 to 146 (+42%), position 16 to 20. Sewer and trenchless cluster up 11 to 48 impressions (the intended target), pipe break 48 to 44, gas (not a service) 1 to 18. Verdict: the rewrite pulls intended searches but no click yet, and the goal is not met.
- Later finding (Sep 26 three-page audit): Google had not recrawled Buckeye since Aug 28, so these reads measured a page Google had not re-read.

# Decisions and status
- Done Sep 15 17:24 UTC with Kim's approval: H2 "Pipe Break Repair in Buckeye" (217 words) and FAQ #8 added (FAQPage now 8 questions). Title, meta and H1 unchanged. Clean data for the combined page starts Sep 16.
- Draft claims checked: no gas, no pipe bursting, "Pipeliners" naming, 24/7 confirmed Aug 27 (later treated as off-limits on city pages).
- Open at the time: og:title still the Aug 31 value; H1 differs from the Doc.
